name: wonda-eval-benchmark-full
description: WONDA-Eval Benchmark Full is a broad evaluation suite for language models that measures performance across diverse NLP tasks including question answering, instruction following, and open-ended generation. It emphasizes factual accuracy, reasoning, and robustness to varied prompt formulations. The benchmark aggregates multiple task types to produce a composite understanding of model capabilities.
reputation: A community benchmark used for broad LLM evaluation with moderate adoption in model comparison studies.
